lines.3: Damn this silent girl. Show a little cooperation.
lines.4: Fine. My brilliant joke would fill this dry, flavorless atmosphere with laughter.
lines.5: 「Hey, Yashi. I've got an American joke for you.」
lines.7: 「How do you buy a cow? With moo-ney.」
lines.9: 「Damn, too difficult? Then I'll tell a regular joke.」
lines.10: 「A little boy fell into the sea.」
lines.12: 「That's not the tired punchline, is it?」
lines.13: 「O-Of course not! What are you talking about?」
lines.14: 「Then what is it? Go on, Senpai.」
lines.15: 「He went crack...? Because he fell onto the rocks.」
lines.17: 「Don't look at me like I'm something filthy!」
lines.19: 「And no looking at me with pity either.」
lines.20: 「You make a lot of demands, Senpai.」
lines.21: The mood died for a moment, but at least I'd managed to start a conversation.
